annotations.text: Direction A (the three big frames): guide-site layout in the existing site tokens. Every number and talent on these boards is the real Protection Warrior data from the repo; nothing invented. Alternates B and C are low-fi sketches of other directions to compare against, not finished pages.

Spec guide anatomy: hero with verdict chips -> sticky section tabs -> Talents (tree split + what each point buys + skip list + 1.18.1 note) -> Leveling path timeline -> Stat priority with caps as big numbers -> Opener + single-target priority + AoE cards -> Cooldowns -> Don'ts -> collapsed sources. Prose lives one click away, never on the main path.
